capabilities: Read notes or selections aloud with text-to-speech from a panel or command
Control playback with pause, rewind, skip, speed and volume
Highlight and scroll to the part currently being read in the editor
Generate audio in the background without playing it
Save generated audio (.mp3 or .wav) in the vault and link it from the note
extras: The plugin itself is free but reading always costs provider API credits; Apple OS local voices are planned but not yet available. Full documentation lives outside the README. Obsidian's plugin scanner reports 'vault enumeration' because the plugin checks other notes' audio-path properties to protect shared saved audio. Known limitations (e.g. HTML comments being read aloud) are listed in the docs. Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have a note read aloud, so users must copy text into a separate TTS service or app.
